newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bangladesh defers closing of kero tender to May 7.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh defers closing of kero tender to May 7.

text.p: State-owned Bangladesh Petroleum Corp (BPC) has deferred the closing date for its tender to buy superior kerosene by one day to May 7 with offers valid to May 15, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The tender seeks 155,000-barrels of kerosene for May 23-24 delivery on a cost-and- freight (c-and-f) basis to Chittagong, they said.
BPC last bought 155,000 barrels of jet fuel from Swiss trader at $1.48 per barrel above Singapore spot quotes for April 22-24 delivery, on a c-and-f basis to Chittagong.
